muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وآتيناهم من الآيات﴾: conjoined to what precedes. «آتيناهم» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the object; «من الآيات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ما فيه بلاء مبين﴾: «ما» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «آتيناهم»; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); «بلاء» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «مبين» is an adjective of «بلاء»; and the clause «فيه بلاء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إن هؤلاء ليقولون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «هؤلاء» is its noun; [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause «إن هؤلاء...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿إن هي إلا موتتنا الأولى﴾: «إن» is negative; «هي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «موتتنا» is the khabar (predicate) of «هي»; and «الأولى» is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وما نحن بمنشرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative «ما», which operates like «ليس»; «نحن» is the noun of «ما»; «بمنشرين»: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and «منشرين» is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī «ما», accusative (manṣūb) in position, genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿فأتوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; «ائتوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿بآبائنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ائتوا».
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿صادقين﴾: its khabar (predicate); the apodosis is omitted, i.e.: "then do that."

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿أهم خير﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «هم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خير» is the khabar (predicate).
﴿أم قوم تبع والذين من قبلهم أهلكناهم﴾: «أم» is a conjunction; «قوم تبع» is conjoined to «هم»; «الذين» is conjoined to «قوم تبع»; «من قبلهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «أهلكناهم» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and «هم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «أهلكناهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the conjoined and what it is conjoined to, or it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إنهم كانوا مجرمين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and the clause «كانوا مجرمين» is its khabar; «كانوا» is a deficient, abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and «مجرمين» is its khabar; the clause «إنهم كانوا مجرمين» is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for their destruction.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وما خلقنا السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive. «ما» is negative, and «خلقنا السماوات» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وما بينهما لاعبين﴾: «ما» is conjoined to «السماوات والأرض»; «بينهما» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «لاعبين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil. The clause «وما خلقنا السماوات...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿ما خلقناهما إلا بالحق﴾: the clause is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the clause «وما خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما لاعبين», with no grammatical position. «ما» is negative; «خلقناهما» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لكن» is an abrogating particle of rectification (istidrāk); «أكثرهم» is its noun; «لا» is negative; «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «لا يعلمون» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿إن يوم الفصل ميقاتهم أجمعين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «يوم» is its noun; «الفصل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «ميقاتهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; and «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun, i.e.: for all people.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿يوم لا يغني مولى عن مولى شيئا﴾: «يوم» is a badal (substitute) from «يوم الفصل», or an adverb (ẓarf) for what «الفصل» indicates, i.e.: He will judge between them on a day on which [no patron] will avail. «لا» is negative; «يغني» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); «مولى» is the fāʿil (agent); «عن مولى» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يغني»; «شيئًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: [availing] a little or a lot; and the clause «لا يغني» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿ولا هم ينصرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is negative; «هم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «ينصرون» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «ينصرون» is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿إلا من رحم الله﴾: «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «مَن» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a badal (substitute) from the wāw in «ينصرون», or accusative (manṣūb) as an excepted [noun], i.e.: but those on whom Allah has mercy will not be afflicted by anything for which they would need a created being to benefit them; or the exception is connected (muttaṣil), its implied form being: no relative will avail a relative, except the believers. The clause «رحم الله», a verb and its fāʿil (agent), is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿إنه هو العزيز الرحيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; «هو» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «العزيز الرحيم» are two khabars (predicates) of «هو», and the clause is the khabar of «إن»; or «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and «العزيز الرحيم» are two khabars of «إن».

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿إن شجرة الزقوم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «شجرة» is its noun; and «الزقوم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿طعام الأثيم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) in the previous ayah.
[Translator's note: strictly, «طعام» is the khabar of «إن» in the previous ayah, whose noun is «شجرة»; translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿كالمهل يغلي في البطون﴾: «كالمهل»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a second khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «المهل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «يغلي» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); the clause «يغلي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الزقوم», or from «طعام الأثيم»; and «في البطون» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يغلي».

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿كغلي الحميم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: it boils with a boiling like the boiling of scalding water; «غلي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «الحميم» is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿خذوه﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is the speech reported by an omitted verb of saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf).
﴿فاعتلوه﴾: an imperative verb, conjoined to «خذوه».
﴿إلى سواء الجحيم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اعتلوه».

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿ثم صبوا﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with delay; «صبوا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فوق رأسه من عذاب الحميم﴾: «فوق رأسه» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صبوا»; «من» is a connective (ṣila) particle; «عذاب الحميم» is genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿ذق إنك أنت العزيز الكريم﴾: the clause is the speech reported by an omitted verb of saying, i.e.: and it will be said to him: "Taste!". «ذق» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun; «أنت» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «العزيز الكريم» are two khabars (predicates) of «أنت», and the nominal clause is the khabar of «إن»; or «أنت» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and «العزيز الكريم» are two khabars of «إن». The clause «إنك أنت العزيز الكريم» is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿إن هذا ما كنتم به تمترون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «هذا» is its noun; «ما» is its khabar (predicate); «كنتم» is a deficient, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تمترون»; «تمترون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «تمترون» is the khabar of «كنتم», and the clause «كنتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿إن المتقين في مقام أمين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «المتقين» is its noun; «في مقام» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); and «أمين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مقام».

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿في جنات وعيون﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) from «في مقام», with the preposition repeated.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿يلبسون من سندس وإستبرق متقابلين﴾: the clause is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن». «يلبسون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «من سندس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يلبسون»; and «متقابلين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «يلبسون».

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿كذلك وزوجناهم بحور عين﴾: «كذلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: the matter is thus; this clause is parenthetical between the conjoined and what it is conjoined to, with no grammatical position, brought for affirmation. «زوجناهم» is a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), conjoined to «يلبسون»; «بحور» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «زوجناهم»; and «عين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حور».

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿يدعون فيها بكل فاكهة آمنين﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «زوجناهم». «يدعون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl; «بكل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يدعون»; and «آمنين» is a ḥāl, i.e.: they do not fear any ill consequence of eating it.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿لا يذوقون فيها الموت إلا الموتة الأولى﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «آمنين». «لا» is negative; «يذوقون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl; «الموت» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلا» is a particle of exception; «الموتة» is excepted from «الموت», the exception being disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); and «الأولى» is an adjective.
﴿ووقاهم عذاب الجحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «وقاهم» is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; «هم» is the mafʿūl bihi, and «عذاب الجحيم» is a second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿فضلا﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: He bestowed a bounty — and it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar); or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of «فضلًا».
﴿ذلك﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هو﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿الفوز﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿العظيم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «الفوز»; or «هو» is a second mubtadaʾ, and «الفوز» is its khabar, and the nominal clause is the khabar of «ذلك».

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿فإنما يسرناه بلسانك﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; «إنما» is a restraining [particle] and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «يسرناه» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بلسانك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسرناه».
﴿لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «هم» is its noun; «يتذكرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «يتذكرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل».

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿فارتقب إنهم مرتقبون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; «ارتقب» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); its object is omitted, its implied form being "their destruction" (هلاكهم). «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and «مرتقبون» is its khabar (predicate); the object of «مرتقبون» is also omitted, its implied form being "your destruction" (هلاكك). The clause «إنهم مرتقبون» is causal (taʿlīliyya), giving the reason for the command to wait.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿حم﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿والكتاب المبين﴾: the wāw is the wāw of oath; ﴿الكتاب﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being «أقسم» (I swear); ﴿المبين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of «الكتاب».

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿إنا أنزلناه في ليلة مباركة﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿أنزلناه﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; ﴿في ليلة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلناه﴾; ﴿مباركة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ليلة﴾; the clause ﴿إنا أنزلناه﴾ is the answer of the oath (jawāb al-qasam).
﴿إنا كنا منذرين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿منذرين﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is the khabar of «إن». The clause ﴿إنا كنا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is also an answer of the oath, or because it is resumptive, or because it is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) between the qualifier — namely His words ﴿فيها يفرق كل أمر﴾ — and the qualified ﴿ليلة﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿فيها يفرق كل أمر حكيم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿ليلة﴾. ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفرق﴾; ﴿يفرق﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿كل أمر﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿حكيم﴾ is a ṣifa of ﴿أمر﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿أمرا﴾: ﴿أمرا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿أنزلناه﴾ or of its object, i.e. We sent it down commanding, or [it being] commanded; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), whose governor is either «أنزلناه», or «منذرين», or «يُفْرَق»; or ﴿أمرا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being «أمرنا أمرًا من عندنا» (We commanded a command from Us); or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is in the sense of the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «يُفْرَق», i.e. a separating; or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿منذرين﴾, the first object being omitted, i.e. warning people of a command.
﴿من عندنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿أمرا﴾.
﴿إنا كنا مرسلين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿مرسلين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كنا﴾; the clause ﴿كنا مرسلين﴾ is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿رحمة من ربك﴾: ﴿رحمة﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the governor of which is either ﴿أنزلناه﴾, or ﴿أمرًا﴾, or ﴿يفرق﴾, or ﴿منذرين﴾; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) made accusative by an implied verb, i.e. «رحمنا رحمة» (We showed mercy); or an object of ﴿مرسلين﴾; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of ﴿مرسلين﴾, i.e. possessors of mercy; or a badal (substitute) of ﴿أمرًا﴾. ﴿من ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿رحمة﴾, or attached to the word «رحمة» itself.
﴿إنه هو السميع العليم﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿السميع العليم﴾ are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿هو﴾, and the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿السميع العليم﴾ are two khabars of ﴿إنه﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما إن كنتم موقنين﴾: ﴿رب السماوات والأرض﴾ is a badal (substitute) of ﴿ربك﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to ﴿السماوات والأرض﴾; ﴿بينهما﴾ is an adverb [attached to] the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the text; the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», as «كان» takes a noun, not a fāʿil]; ﴿موقنين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كنتم﴾; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being «فأيقنوا بأن محمدًا رسوله» (then be certain that Muḥammad is His Messenger).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) of the position of «لا» and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal of the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is also a khabar of ﴿إن﴾ in the sixth ayah.
﴿يحيي ويميت ربكم ورب آبائكم الأولين﴾: «يحيي»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). «يميت»: conjoined to «يحيي». ﴿ربكم﴾ is a fourth khabar, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿رب آبائكم الأولين﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿بل هم في شك يلعبون﴾: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) from an omitted [statement], as though He said: so they are not certain; rather, they are in doubt according to their inner thoughts. ﴿هم﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في شك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿يلعبون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يلعبون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿فارتقب يوم تأتي السماء بدخان مبين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); ﴿ارتقب﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ارتقب﴾; ﴿تأتي﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿السماء﴾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿تأتي السماء﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿بدخان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تأتي﴾; ﴿مبين﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿دخان﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿يغشى الناس هذا عذاب أليم﴾: the clause is in the position of a genitive, also a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿دخان﴾; «يغشى» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); ﴿الناس﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿هذا﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿عذاب﴾ is khabar (predicate), and ﴿أليم﴾ is a ṣifa of ﴿عذاب﴾; the clause is the maqūl (object of speech) of an omitted saying, and the clause of saying is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. saying to your Lord.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ربنا اكشف عنا العذاب﴾: ﴿ربنا﴾ is an annexed (muḍāf) vocative; ﴿اكشف﴾ is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "You" (أنت); ﴿عنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اكشف﴾; ﴿العذاب﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنا مؤمنون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿مؤمنون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason for the supplication.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿أنى لهم الذكرى﴾: ﴿أنى﴾ is an interrogative noun in the sense of «كيف» (how), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿الذكرى﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿وقد جاءهم رسول مبين﴾: ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿جاءهم﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿هم﴾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿رسول﴾ is a postponed fāʿil (agent); ﴿مبين﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون﴾: ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿تولوا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the conjoining is to an omitted [clause], i.e. «فلم يذكروا ثم تولوا» (so they did not take heed, then they turned away); ﴿عنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تولوا﴾; ﴿قالوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تولوا﴾; ﴿معلم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مجنون﴾ is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿إنا كاشفو العذاب قليلا﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿كاشفو العذاب﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿قليلًا﴾ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كاشفو﴾.
﴿إنكم عائدون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, the kāf is its noun, and ﴿عائدون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿يوم نبطش البطشة الكبرى﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb] indicated by ﴿إنا منتقمون﴾, i.e. We will take vengeance; and it has been said: it is a badal (substitute) of ﴿يوم تأتي﴾; and it has been said: it is accusative by an implied «اذكر» (remember); and it has been said: by ﴿منتقمون﴾. The clause ﴿نبطش﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿البطشة﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); ﴿الكبرى﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective).
﴿إنا منتقمون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿منتقمون﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿ولقد فتنا قبلهم قوم فرعون وجاءهم رسول كريم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the lām is [in] the answer of the omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿فتنا﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿قبلهم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فتنا﴾; ﴿قوم فرعون﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وجاءهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿جاءهم﴾ is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi; ﴿رسول﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿كريم﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿أن أدوا إلي عباد الله﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because the coming of the messengers is only with a call, and that includes the sense of saying; ﴿أدوا﴾ is an imperative verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أدوا﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن أدوا» (with [the message]: deliver); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾, and the clause ﴿أدوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is lightened from the heavy [«أنّ»], its noun being an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause ﴿أدوا﴾ is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of the lightened «أن». ﴿عباد الله﴾ is an annexed (muḍāf) vocative from which the vocative particle has been omitted; and it has been said: ﴿عباد الله﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إني لكم رسول أمين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿رسول﴾ is the khabar of ﴿إني﴾; ﴿أمين﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وأن لا تعلوا على الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive, and ﴿تعلوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن لا تعلوا» (with [the message]: do not exalt yourselves), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾. The clause ﴿أدوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position [Translator's note: so in the text, copied from the previous ayah; here the clause meant is «لا تعلوا»]. Or ﴿أن﴾ is lightened from the heavy [«أنّ»], its noun being an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause ﴿لا تعلوا﴾ is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of the lightened ﴿أن﴾. ﴿على الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعلوا﴾.
﴿إني آتيكم بسلطان مبين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿آتيكم﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿آتيكم﴾ is the khabar of «إن»; ﴿بسلطان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آتيكم﴾; ﴿مبين﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective); the clause gives the reason for the prohibition, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وإني عذت بربي وربكم أن ترجمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿عذت﴾ is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿عذت﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; ﴿بربي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عذت﴾; ﴿ربكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بربي﴾; ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿ترجمون﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿عُذت﴾, i.e. «من أن ترجمون» (from your stoning me); the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the object of «ترجمون».

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وإن لم تؤمنوا لي فاعتزلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; ﴿تؤمنوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is connective; ﴿اعتزلون﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿اعتزلون﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿فدعا ربه أن هؤلاء قوم مجرمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the statement is conjoined to an implied [clause], its implied form being «فلم يتركوه» (but they did not leave him alone); ﴿دعا﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿ربه﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «هؤلاء» is its noun; ﴿قوم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; «مجرمون» is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿قوم﴾; ﴿أن﴾ together with what it governs is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن هؤلاء» (that these…), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دعا﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿فأسر بعبادي ليلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the eloquent fāʾ); ﴿بعبادي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسر﴾; ﴿ليلًا﴾ is an adverb of time, also attached to ﴿أسر﴾.
﴿إنكم متبعون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, and ﴿متبعون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason for the command to travel by night.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿واترك البحر رهوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿اترك﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «البحر» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿رهوًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿اترك﴾.
﴿إنهم جند مغرقون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and ﴿جند﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿مغرقون﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿جند﴾; the clause gives the reason for the command to leave [the sea].

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿كم تركوا من جنات وعيون﴾: the statement is linked to an implied [one], the implied form being «فاطمأن موسى بذلك فتم إغراقهم» (so Mūsā was reassured by that, and their drowning was accomplished); ﴿كم﴾ is predicative (khabariyya), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تركوا﴾; ﴿تركوا﴾ is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿جنات﴾ is the tamyīz (specification) of ﴿كم﴾, genitive (majrūr) by ﴿من﴾, accusative in position; ﴿عيون﴾ is conjoined to the form of ﴿جنات﴾, genitive.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وزروع ومقام كريم﴾: conjoined to ﴿جنات وعيون﴾; ﴿كريم﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective), genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿ونعمة كانوا فيها فاكهين﴾: also conjoined; ﴿كانوا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun; ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فاكهين﴾; ﴿فاكهين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كانوا﴾; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿نعمة﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿كذلك وأورثناها قوما آخرين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being «الأمر مثل ذلك» (the matter is like that); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أورثناها﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to ﴿كم تركوا﴾; ﴿قومًا﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿آخرين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فما بكت عليهم السماء والأرض﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the statement is conjoined to the implied clause «أغرقوا» (they were drowned); ﴿بكت﴾ is a past verb; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بكت﴾; ﴿السماء﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿السماء﴾.
﴿وما كانوا منظرين﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿كانوا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and ﴿منظرين﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿ولقد نجينا بني إسرائيل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the lām is [in] the answer of the omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿نجينا﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بني إسرائيل﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من العذاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نجينا﴾; ﴿المهين﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective) of «العذاب».

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿من فرعون﴾: ﴿من فرعون﴾ is a badal (substitute) of His words ﴿من العذاب﴾, with repetition of the preposition; and it has been said: it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «العذاب», i.e. being, or issuing, from Firʿawn.
﴿إنه كان عاليا من المسرفين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause «كان» is its khabar (predicate); ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, its noun latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿عاليًا﴾ is its khabar; ﴿من المسرفين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; the clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what follows it has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ولقد اخترناهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is [in] the answer of the omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿اخترناهم﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿على علم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿على العالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اخترناهم﴾.
